transcript.answer:
**No—interest in astronomy is declining significantly in Ukrainian Wikipedia, and we can trust this finding.**

The astronomy article (Астрономія) lost **45.5% of its share of attention** in Ukrainian Wikipedia over the last 12 months (90% range -52.1% to -33.7%), with **high confidence**. The decline is consistent: 10 of the 12 months showed lower views than the same month a year earlier. This already factors out the 24.6% decline in Ukrainian Wikipedia's overall traffic, so it's a real loss of interest in astronomy specifically, not just a general slowdown on the site.

The one wrinkle: astronomy has a strong seasonal peak in September (176.5% above average), so November–August are quieter months. But the year-over-year decline held across all seasons.

**Trust level: High.** The pattern is consistent and the confidence range is tight (18 percentage points), supported by 10 months of data moving in the same direction.

**What's next?** This pageview signal tells you that Ukrainian Wikipedia readers are paying less attention to astronomy, but not why—whether it's a shift to other languages' Wikipedias, to other sources online, or a genuine drop in interest. If you're deciding whether to invest in Ukrainian astronomy content, you'd want to validate this with other signals (traffic from Ukrainian astronomy sites, interest in astronomy courses, search trends in Ukrainian).
